title: WS-031 - Publish a survey or schedule automatic publication
intent: Explain how to publish a survey immediately or set automatic publishing dates through the API.
short_answer: Use publishSurvey to publish a survey immediately when no start or end dates are provided, or to enable automatic publishing when start and end dates are provided. API summary Status Active Endpoint <base_url>/webservice/publishSurvey/[Alias]/[Start]/[End] Supported method(s) GET Required privilege Authenticated system user allowed for the survey Parameters and input Alias Survey alias. Start/End Optional publication time frame in yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss. Minutes and seconds should be 00; other values are automatically replaced by 00. Expected output Returns 1 if the survey was published successfully or the automatic publication dates were saved. Returns 0 if the survey is already published. Main HTTP responses 200 OK Publish operation completed. 412 Precondition Failed Survey does not exist or survey is already published. 403 Forbidden Wrong username/password, missing required privilege, or user not allowed to perform the operation. 404 Not Found Unknown service or missing parameters. 412 Precondition Failed A prerequisite is not met, such as missing survey, wrong parameter format, archived survey, or invalid identifier. 429 Too Many Requests Daily API request limit exceeded.
